general_rules.json_root: Every JSON artifact listed below must have a JSON object as its root.
general_rules.numbers: Use JSON numbers without unit suffixes. Lengths are millimetres, mass is grams, and volume is cubic millimetres.
general_rules.filenames: Use the artifact filenames exactly as written in this contract.
general_rules.extra_fields: Additional descriptive fields and additional CSV columns are allowed, but every required field and column must be present.

row_rules: Write one row for every KiCad component and mounting hole used by the mechanical handoff.
ref, kind, position, height, and keepout radius come from board_input.kicad_pcb and connector_keepouts.csv.
Use role=connector_window, access_bore, antenna_keepout, or component_keepout as appropriate for component-derived geometry.

required_fields.board_bbox_mm: number[3]: [width, height, board thickness] extracted from KiCad
required_fields.max_component_height_mm: number: maximum height_mm among the component objects

required_fields.enclosure_bbox_mm: number[3] measured from the generated OpenSCAD enclosure
required_fields.window_count: integer: number of required connector/access openings

required_fields.board_bbox_mm: number[3] copied from the KiCad export
required_fields.decision: string: pass when the required clearances and interference checks pass
required_fields.enclosure_bbox_mm: number[3] copied from the OpenSCAD parameters
required_fields.estimated_shell_mass_g: number computed from the assembled enclosure
required_fields.keepout_count: integer: number of component-derived keepouts checked

required_fields.camera: object with name=release_review_camera, projection=orthographic, and view=top_oblique
required_fields.collections: string array containing KiCad_board, OpenSCAD_enclosure, FreeCAD_clearance_overlays, and critical_keepouts
required_fields.decision: string: pass when review-scene checks pass
required_fields.materials: string array containing enclosure_translucent, pcb_green, and keepout_warning
required_fields.mesh_qc: object with integer fields missing_material_slots, nonmanifold_edges, and unlabeled_keepouts; all must be 0 for pass
required_fields.visible_keepouts: string array containing every critical reference that must be visible in the review

required_fields.release_decision: string: pass when all stages pass
required_fields.required_artifacts: string array containing all 15 output artifacts named in the instruction
required_fields.software_sequence: string array exactly [KiCad, OpenSCAD, FreeCAD, Blender]
required_fields.stage_outputs: object mapping KiCad, OpenSCAD, FreeCAD, and Blender to their output filename arrays
required_fields.title: string copied from mechanical_requirements.json

required_fields.commands: array of exactly four command records in KiCad, OpenSCAD, FreeCAD, Blender order

required_fields.command: non-empty string containing the command actually run
